observation_window.sampling: provider default; not continuous motion capture

observation.setting: A large paved public plaza outdoors, surrounded by modern buildings and a crowd of onlookers holding cameras and phones.
observation.dancers: A large group of mixed participants including children, teenagers, and adults of both men and women, performing in unison as a flash mob.
observation.formation_and_space: Spread out across the open plaza in loose rows and groups facing the same direction, expanding into a large crowd formation.
observation.posture: Upright torso with soft knees, bouncing on the beat, occasionally squatting low.
observation.footwork: Stepping side to side, hopping, and squatting on beat; precise footwork cannot be clearly verified due to camera distance.
observation.arms_and_hands: Arms sweeping out to the sides, hands clapping overhead, pushing forward, and raised in the air.
observation.hips_and_torso: Bouncing torso with occasional knee-bending dips, keeping upper body engaged with arm movements.
observation.partnering: None; solo movement performed in unison within a group.
observation.levels_jumps_turns: Transitions between standing, hopping, and squatting down low toward the ground.
observation.costume_and_props: Casual everyday street clothes such as jeans, t-shirts, jackets, and sweaters; some holding flags.
observation.cannot_infer: Precise weight transfer, individual footwork details, and rapid foot placements are obscured by distance and camera angles.

signature_moments.what: Dancers hop lightly from side to side while extending arms outward.
The group squats down low together while keeping arms in front.
Dancers clap hands overhead in unison while stepping on the beat.
